name: Grandma's Thanksgiving Dressing
author: Patricia Bruner
steps: Cook cornbread mix according to package directions, using 2 of the eggs and the milk.
Use a fork to crumble the cornbread until fine.
Combine with stuffing mix, crushed cracker crumbs, torn bread pieces, diced onion and celery.
Add melted butter, 2 eggs, spices, and enough chicken broth to make dressing soupy.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 until edges are brown and center is cooked through.
